summary: Frontend-only review of the new CircuitTestimonials carousel inserted in MoroccoCircuits (Home section 'circuits-section'). Verified DOM presence, visual style (parchment bg #F8F2E6, 3px accent left border, stars, italic quote, initials avatar, origin + MapPin, 'Viajero verificado' badge), 3-dot navigation, tab-driven content update for all 7 slugs, idx reset on tab switch, auto-rotation (~6.5s), pause-on-hover, CTA regression, no JS console errors, and responsive behaviour across 1440/768/390.
critical_code_review_comments: CircuitTestimonials.jsx uses `border-l-3px` via inline style — fine. Component already destroys timer on slug change because `slug` is in the effect deps; good.

Auto-rotation interval lives only while the section is visible in DOM, which it is once Home is loaded; no IntersectionObserver to stop timer when off-screen — minor optimisation (CPU only), not a bug.
Eyebrow label 'Lo que cuentan los viajeros' is duplicated literal in COPY object — already trilingual, OK.
Good: console reports 0 JS errors after full interaction sweep across 7 slugs.

responsive.desktop_1440: image height=520px, right panel height=520px, diff=0 — perfectly balanced (no whitespace gap, no overflow)
responsive.tablet_768: Side-by-side md grid keeps the testimonial card visible inside the panel; no overlap with blurb or CTA
responsive.mobile_390: Single-column stacking; testimonial card visible, fits panel width, no horizontal overflow

context_for_next_testing_agent: MoroccoCircuits → right panel now contains <CircuitTestimonials slug accent/> between blurb and the mt-auto CTA wrapper. Carousel auto-rotates every 6500ms, pauses on hover, dots in top-right, and resets to first item on slug change via useEffect. All 7 slugs (sahara, imperial, atlas, kasbahs, north, short, adventure) have 3 trilingual testimonios in /app/frontend/src/lib/circuitTestimonials.js. Default app language is ES. Section anchor: data-testid='circuits-section'. No layout-imbalance issue at 1440 (image and panel both 520px).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Note for re-tests: the initial idx=0 quote can drift if the test sleeps longer than 6.5s before reading the first quote (auto-rotation), so always click circuit-testimonial-dot-<slug>-0 to establish a deterministic baseline before assertions.
